grammar_focus: 一般过去时 vs 现在完成时对比(主考:有明确过去时间 in 1994/ago/last month → 一般过去 · 与现在有联系 since/for/up till now/ever/before → 现在完成 · has/have + 过去分词)+ 定语从句 who / 表语从句 that(辅考)
scene: 本·弗西特机长买了一架小型瑞士飞机'皮勒特斯·波特'当'出租汽车',能在雪地、水面甚至耕过的田里降落,已把乘客送到屋顶、废弃停车场等许多稀奇地方;但他刚拒绝了一位商人飞往大西洋孤岛罗卡尔的请求——因为那趟太危险了。

grammar_card.title: 一般过去时 vs 现在完成时
grammar_card.intro: 本课对比两个时态:有明确的过去时间(in 1994 / ago / last month)用一般过去时;和现在有联系(since / for / up till now / ever)用现在完成时。全用本课句子举例。

rows: 有明确过去时间 → 一般过去时
I saw him in 1994. / last month
自从…以来 → 现在完成时(since)
I have not seen him since 1994.
持续一段时间 → 现在完成时(for)
I have not seen him for three years.
至今 / 曾经 → 现在完成时(up till now / ever)

specialRules.rule: ago(…以前)配一般过去;since/for 配现在完成:three years ago(过去)↔ for three years(现在完成)
定语从句 who 指人:a doctor who flew…;表语从句 that:The surprising thing is that it can land anywhere.

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Does Captain Fawcett think any trip is too dangerous?
options: Yes — he refused to fly to Rockall

passage: Captain Ben Fawcett has bought an unusual taxi and has begun a new service. The 'taxi' is a small Swiss airplane called a 'Pilatus Porter'. This wonderful plane can carry seven passengers. The most surprising thing about it, however, is that it can land anywhere: on snow, water, or even on a plowed field. Captain Fawcett's first passenger was a doctor who flew from Birmingham to a lonely village in the Welsh mountains. Since then, Captain Fawcett has flown passengers to many unusual places. Once he landed on the roof of an apartment building and on another occasion, he landed in a deserted parking lot. Captain Fawcett has just refused a strange request from a businessman. The man wanted to fly to Rockall, a lonely island in the Atlantic Ocean, but Captain Fawcett did not take him because the trip was too dangerous.

sentences.text_en: The most surprising thing about it, however, is that it can land anywhere: on snow, water, or even on a plowed field.
sentences.text_cn: 然而,最令人惊奇的是它能够在任何地方降落:雪地上、水面上,甚至刚耕过的田里。

sentences.text_en: Captain Fawcett's first passenger was a doctor who flew from Birmingham to a lonely village in the Welsh mountains.
sentences.text_cn: 弗西特机长的第一名乘客是位医生,他从伯明翰飞往威尔士山区一个偏僻的村庄。

sentences.text_en: Since then, Captain Fawcett has flown passengers to many unusual places.
sentences.text_cn: 从那时起,弗西特机长已经载送乘客到过许多不寻常的地方。

sentences.text_en: Once he landed on the roof of an apartment building and on another occasion, he landed in a deserted parking lot.
sentences.text_cn: 一次,他把飞机降落在了一栋公寓楼的屋顶上;还有一次,降落在了一个废弃的停车场上。

sentences.text_en: Captain Fawcett has just refused a strange request from a businessman.
sentences.text_cn: 弗西特机长刚刚拒绝了一位商人的奇特要求。

sentences.text_en: The man wanted to fly to Rockall, a lonely island in the Atlantic Ocean, but Captain Fawcett did not take him because the trip was too dangerous.
sentences.text_cn: 这个人想要飞往大西洋上的一个孤岛——罗卡尔岛,弗西特机长之所以不送他去,是因为那趟飞行太危险了。

grammar_points.name: 一般过去时:有明确过去时间(in 1994/ago/last month)
现在完成时:since + 过去时间点(自从)
现在完成时:for + 一段时间(持续)
现在完成时:has/have + 过去分词
一般过去 vs 现在完成:看信号词选时态
定语从句 who / which(指人/指物,辅考)
表语从句 that(is that…,辅考)

stage5.stem: "I have not seen him ___ three years."(接一段时间:达三年)
"They ___ known each other for years."(持续多年:现在完成)
"Have you ___ stayed at this hotel?"(问经历'曾经':现在完成)
"Up till now, I have ___ been abroad."(至今'从未':现在完成)

stage5.stem_cn: 弗西特机长买了一辆不寻常的出租车。

stage5.stem_cn: 他的第一位乘客是位飞往村庄的医生。

stage5.stem: "The 'taxi' ___ can land anywhere is a Swiss plane."(指物,作主语)

stage5.stem: "The most surprising thing is ___ it can land anywhere."(is 后引出后面的从句)
stage5.stem_cn: 最令人惊奇的是它能在任何地方降落。

stage5.stem: "The truth is ___ the trip was too dangerous."(is 后引出后面的从句)
stage5.stem_cn: 事实是那次飞行太危险了。
